   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 18 jun 2026 - 29 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _beescobee_, 29 ago 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately this app has been unusable for me. The AI ads (ads for games that use AI art and AI-generated people playing them) don’t go away and the fact that so much of this app consists of AI (the music, the art) is really annoying and disappointing. Also, I have a feeling Nintendo will sue them for using songs from their games… I highly doubt they had those approved. The only feature I enjoyed was the fact that people are utilizing this to get things done but honestly, you don’t need the app to do this."
            2. _handysuchtiii_, 18 jun 2026, 1/5: "The app crashes a few seconds after I open it."
            3. _katsilt_, 24 ago 2026, 2/5: "the app kept crashing no matter what i did"
